show.description: A billionaire CEO disguises himself as a beggar to find true love—only to marry a woman who betrays him for money, power, and passion. When her secret affair crashes headfirst into his world, love turns into war. What follows is a brutal game of deception, revenge, and redemption, where loyalty bleeds, masks fall, and a broken man must choose between destroying his past or saving the one soul who truly stood by him.
